description: Plugin invokes one bounded host operation; capability evaluated per invocation; the daemon result carries the superset vocabulary (success+ok+status+reason in three spellings) and a host-authored external_receipt
source: the AII OS BBB conformance vectors
checked_by: framing round-trip now; result-vocabulary decode is a host obligation

vectors.name: request_minimal
vectors.note: both SDK clients require target and arguments to be JSON objects

vectors.name: request_cancellable
vectors.note: work_done_token requires the rpc.cancel capability negotiated at connect

vectors.name: response_success_superset
vectors.note: success+ok satisfy the C client decoder, status satisfies the Go client decoder, top-level body is the legacy duplicate; receipt fields (further audit fields elided)

vectors.name: response_denied_as_result
vectors.note: same code string in all three spellings; one of the C client's five denial reason codes

vectors.name: response_cancelled_as_result
vectors.note: the cancelled path emits NO status field and only the snake reason_code (the Go SDK client misreads this as succeeded); receipt id is the work_done_token when set

vectors.name: response_denied_as_error
vectors.payload_utf8: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"error":{"code":-32000,"message":"Capability scope does not admit the requested operation","data":{"reasonCode":"OPERATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH","denied_at":"capability"}}}
vectors.note: capability-preparation denials arrive as errors, execution denials as results; clients must handle both (AUDIT section 8)

expect.message: grant is retired; invoke.call evaluates capability per request

vectors.name: invalid_token_without_negotiated_cancel
vectors.note: invalid only for a session that did not negotiate rpc.cancel (every Go-SDK-client plugin today)
